{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "moral",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning her rehearsed wish in front of the assembly and blurring the wording to avoid naming the wound aloud, forcing Lirael to decide whether to intervene or let the rite twist",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren names her offering aloud before the wish—her earliest memory—and begins the invocation exactly as rehearsed, but then hesitates, her voice trembling as she abandons the practiced words.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s eyes flick to the presiding Dohkar, who watches with detached professionalism, his posture rigid as if waiting for the next procedural step",
      "Seren’s gaze darts to Lirael, her fingers tightening around the ceremonial sash, then releasing as she blurts out the wish in a rush, the words stumbling over themselves"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Do I pull the band away now—risk breaking protocol to stop this—or let the rite twist and hope the Dohkar doesn’t call for the cost before the miracle?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass underfoot, still and untrampled except where Seren’s bare feet have pressed it",
      "the white weeping-willow veil-canopy swaying slightly in the dawn breeze, its edges brushing the gathered First Favored"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": null,
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1: I tugged the ceremonial sash tighter across my chest, the weight of the ornamented band pulling at my collarbone—*this is what I was trained for*, I told myself, though my hands were already shaking.",
    "scene_want": "I want the Dohkar to notice the misalignment in Seren’s wish before he demands the cost aloud, so the rite can be corrected without drawing attention to the wound itself.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop the rite from twisting by halting Seren’s wish before the Dohkar calls for the cost, without naming the wound plainly in front of the assembly.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is performing her First Sacrifice in a Veilwood clearing, her wish is unraveling in front of witnesses, and Lirael must intervene to prevent the rite from twisting",
      "believes": "The Dohkar’s judgment will decide whether the wish can be corrected or if the cost must be spoken aloud, exposing the wound in the process",
      "wondering": "What will happen if Lirael breaks protocol to stop the rite?",
      "must_not_confuse": "The Dohkar is not Seren’s mentor; the ceremony’s order is invocation → sacrifice → desire; the band across Lirael’s mouth is only for decorum, not magic."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "beat 2: stress_tic (the ceremonial sash)",
    "li_body_callback": null,
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ],
    "scene_skeleton": {
      "character_plus": [
        {
          "character": "Seren",
          "mode": "IN_PERSON",
          "option_id": "OPT-4",
          "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
          "first_mention": true,
          "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers tighten around the ceremonial sash, then release as she blurts out the wish in a rush, her voice wavering with the effort to blur the wound’s name.",
          "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
          "behavior_person_ids": [],
          "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
          "pc_interpretation": "Seren is trying to protect someone—maybe even me—by hiding the wound’s name, but she’s making it worse by not speaking it plainly."
        },
        {
          "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
          "mode": "IN_PERSON",
          "option_id": "OPT-6",
          "expression_mode": "CONCEAL",
          "first_mention": true,
          "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s posture remains rigid, his gaze fixed on Seren’s mouth as if waiting for the next procedural step, but his fingers twitch slightly at his sides—an almost imperceptible sign of impatience.",
          "behavior_object_ids": [],
          "behavior_person_ids": [],
          "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
          "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar is judging this misalignment, but he’s holding back—either because he’s used to it or because he doesn’t want to embarrass Seren."
        }
      ],
      "environment_plus": {
        "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass",
        "axis": "damage",
        "beat": "the carpet where Seren’s bare feet have pressed it shows faint, uneven indentations—where she hesitated before abandoning the rehearsed wish, her weight shifting as she struggled to speak the blurred words."
      },
      "pc_opening_fusion": {
        "character": "Lirael",
        "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
        "character_angle": "Her hesitation in pulling the ceremonial sash tighter reveals she’s already calculating how to intervene without breaking protocol—her body is ahead of her mind.",
        "environment_target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass",
        "environment_axis": "damage",
        "beat": "I step forward, my bare foot pressing into the carpet where Seren’s weight has already shifted, my breath catching as I realize the Dohkar’s gaze is locked on Seren’s mouth—waiting for the next step."
      }
    }
  }
}
